name: CMOS two-output analog crosspoint
description: Four transmission gates and two select-complement inverters route either of two inputs independently to each output. Twelve MOS, two 1 pF loads and two leakage resistors are explicit. All four routing commands are exercised at two input pairs, giving 16 output checks, including both broadcast states and the two permutations. Unlike a single-output mux or fixed differential commutator, each output has an independent address. Break-before-make timing, loading, crosstalk, switching spikes and PVT are not qualified.
